name: Please Connect USB -Dennou Idol no Jijou-
original_name: Please Connect USB -電脳アイドル の じじょう-
source:
A story set in the future where virtual reality has become commonplace.
Kei happens to become the boyfriend of some net idol sisters. Kei has one sweet day after another with those loli girls.

However, soon their days will be overcome by an onslaught of violation they can't escape from.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ042786.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
